r03.caption:
Upwork pe sab hain, bhai. Yeh teen spots pe kam log jaate hain.

Swipe karo, yeh teen cheezein dekho:
1. Hacker News ka freelancer thread. Companies wahan seedha freelancer dhoondti hain.
2. Clutch. Free profile banao, buyers wahan agencies dhoondte hain.
3. Sortlist. Free listing, aur buyers wahan agency dhoondte hain.

Fees aur rules badalte rehte hain, platform par ek baar check kar lein.

Save kar lo, aur kisi freelancer dost ko bhejo.

List chahiye? Comment "HIDDEN" karein, hum aapko DM kar denge.

r04.caption:
Chalis proposals, reply zero. Bhai, scene kya hai?

Swipe karo, yeh teen cheezein dekho:
1. Pehli line mein client ki problem bolo, apna intro nahi.
2. Ek relevant project ka proof do, bas do line mein.
3. End mein ek sawaal pucho, taaki reply banta ho.

Save kar lo, aur kisi freelancer dost ko bhejo.
